target: Ubuntu production host shared with platform and isolated generated components
frontend: React + TypeScript + Vite static build; same-origin canonical API via Nginx

capabilities.realization: Custom nodes/edges; Controls and MiniMap; screen-reader and keyboard labels must be localized
capabilities.limitations: No automatic backend validation; positions never authorize a binding; manual layout or explicit layout engine required

capabilities.realization: Animate one finite path traversal from persisted event receipt
capabilities.limitations: No React Flow animated=true infinite dashed animation; no synthetic traffic

capabilities.realization: Pointer and keyboard sensors outside graph; React Flow native node movement inside graph
capabilities.limitations: HTML drag-and-drop alone does not cover touch; same operation exposed by menu and keyboard

capabilities.realization: ContextMenu for right click; DropdownMenu for visible actions button
capabilities.limitations: Same command list in both; collision placement; do not hide touch actions

capabilities.realization: Focus and hover descriptions with aria-describedby
capabilities.limitations: Touch uses info button; critical validation is inline, not tooltip-only

capabilities.realization: Dialog focus trap, accessible title and focus return; CSS side-sheet presentation
capabilities.limitations: Run progress is non-modal; confirmation/human input uses modal only when required

capabilities.realization: Headless row model + separate virtualization; server paging
capabilities.limitations: Virtualization is not built into Table; export reads full authorized dataset, not viewport rows

capabilities.realization: Same-origin authenticated SSE with cursor and reconnection
capabilities.limitations: Native EventSource cannot attach arbitrary Authorization header; use HttpOnly session; no credentials in URL

capabilities.library: native File API + authenticated artifact service
capabilities.realization: Upload/drop, typed artifact handles, immutable downloads
capabilities.limitations: No arbitrary filesystem paths; server MIME/size checks precede preview

capabilities.realization: CSV parsing and server-side workbook reads; return bounded typed row pages
capabilities.limitations: No macros or formula execution; do not load giant workbooks into UI

capabilities.realization: Sanitized HTML preview inside sandboxed frame
capabilities.limitations: No scripts, forms, remote images or credential-bearing links loaded by default
Only authenticated artifact bytes; block active content; download fallback

releaseGate: Exact lockfile + install/compile/browser tests required before implementation release. Registry version lookup and documentation review alone do not prove binary compatibility.
referenceRendering: HTML/CSS/SVG references reproduce geometry and state presentation; backend actions display contract binding, never fabricate success

responsive.desktop: persistent sidebar; graph + 360px inspector; nonmodal progress dock
responsive.tablet: compact navigation; graph full width; inspector below graph or dismissible drawer
responsive.mobile: single column object list equivalent to graph; full-width inspector; visible Actions button; graph optional pan canvas
responsive.motionReduced: no movement; direction and count remain visible
